course_name: 永磁同步電動機之理論與控制
outline: This course begins with the theory of basic electromagnetic energy conversion, followed by the modeling and vector control theory for permanent-magnet synchronous motor, design and control of brushless dc motors, and the driving circuit design for these motors. Finally, sensorless PM machine control techniques are introduced.
schedule:
1. Electromagnetic energy conversion
2. PM and magnetic circuit
3. BLDC basics
4. Stator and rotor design
5. Stator and rotor design
6. Motor drive and control
7. BLDC sensorless control
8. PMSM basics , Mid-term exam
9. Complex vector transformation
10. Mathematical model
11. Vector control, Maximum torque control
12. Current control
13. Sinusoidal PWM
14. Space Vector PWM
15. Initial position sensing
16. Sensorless vector control
17. Sensorless vector control
18. Final exam
assessment:
Home works: 20%
Mid-term exam: 40%
Final exam: 40%
